policy: New direct production dependencies require a PR adding an entry to this file before merge. See docs/security/DEPENDENCY_ACCEPTANCE.md. Transitive deps are NOT inventoried here (YAGNI); they are covered by automated dependency scanning.

dependencies.name: androidx.core:core-ktx
dependencies.purpose: Kotlin extensions for Android core primitives (Activity/Context helpers).
dependencies.security_relevance: Core Android framework glue; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Baseline AndroidX Kotlin extensions used across all activities/services.

dependencies.name: androidx.appcompat:appcompat
dependencies.security_relevance: UI infrastructure; no direct sensitive-data handling.
dependencies.why_needed: Backwards-compatible View-system activity support for legacy screens.

dependencies.name: com.google.android.material:material
dependencies.security_relevance: UI components only; no sensitive flows.
dependencies.why_needed: Material Design widgets for the release UI.

dependencies.name: androidx.constraintlayout:constraintlayout
dependencies.security_relevance: Layout engine; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Used by legacy View-system layouts.

dependencies.name: androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-runtime-ktx
dependencies.security_relevance: Lifecycle glue; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Lifecycle observation for ViewModels and services.

dependencies.name: androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-viewmodel-ktx
dependencies.purpose: ViewModel implementation for MVVM (Dashboard/Scanner view models).
dependencies.security_relevance: Holds UI state; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: MVVM architecture; manual constructor injection used.

dependencies.name: androidx.lifecycle:lifecycle-viewmodel-compose
dependencies.security_relevance: UI state; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Bridges Compose UI with ViewModel state holders.

dependencies.name: androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences
dependencies.purpose: Preferences DataStore for persisting UserSettings (replaces SharedPreferences).
dependencies.security_relevance: Stores user settings on-device; no remote transmission.
dependencies.why_needed: Type-safe, coroutine-based settings persistence.

dependencies.name: androidx.work:work-runtime-ktx
dependencies.security_relevance: Schedules background work; review for battery/background limits.
dependencies.why_needed: Battery-aware Guardian Score pulse scheduling.

dependencies.name: androidx.compose:compose-bom
dependencies.purpose: Bill of Materials aligning Compose library versions.
dependencies.security_relevance: Version alignment only (platform); not shipped as code.
dependencies.why_needed: Pins consistent Compose artifact versions.

dependencies.name: androidx.compose.ui:ui
dependencies.security_relevance: UI toolkit; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Compose UI rendering for MainActivity screens.

dependencies.name: androidx.compose.ui:ui-graphics
dependencies.security_relevance: UI graphics; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Compose graphics support.

dependencies.name: androidx.compose.ui:ui-tooling-preview
dependencies.purpose: Compose @Preview support for the release build.
dependencies.security_relevance: Tooling only; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Compose preview rendering in release builds.

dependencies.name: androidx.compose.material3:material3
dependencies.security_relevance: UI components; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Material 3 design system for Compose UI.

dependencies.name: androidx.compose.material:material-icons-extended
dependencies.purpose: Extended Material icon set for Compose.
dependencies.security_relevance: Icon assets; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Icons used across Compose screens.

dependencies.name: androidx.activity:activity-compose
dependencies.security_relevance: Activity UI glue; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Hosts Compose content in MainActivity.

dependencies.name: androidx.navigation:navigation-compose
dependencies.security_relevance: UI navigation; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: In-app screen routing for Compose.

dependencies.name: org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-core
dependencies.security_relevance: Concurrency runtime; review threading of sensitive work.
dependencies.why_needed: Async/coroutine support across networking and scanning.

dependencies.name: androidx.biometric:biometric
dependencies.security_relevance: Touches local biometric authentication; sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Device biometric unlock for sensitive settings.

dependencies.name: com.android.billingclient:billing-ktx
dependencies.purpose: Google Play Billing Library for Premium subscriptions.
dependencies.security_relevance: Handles purchase/entitlement flows and obfuscated account IDs; sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Premium subscription entitlement via Google Play.

dependencies.name: androidx.room:room-runtime
dependencies.security_relevance: On-device local database; review for sensitive row data.
dependencies.why_needed: Local structured storage of scan findings and settings.

dependencies.name: androidx.room:room-ktx
dependencies.security_relevance: DB access glue; not separately sensitive from room-runtime.
dependencies.why_needed: Coroutine-friendly DB access.

dependencies.name: androidx.room:room-compiler
dependencies.purpose: Room annotation processor (kapt, compile-time only; not shipped).
dependencies.security_relevance: Compile-time code generator; not in runtime APK.
dependencies.why_needed: Generates Room DAO implementations at build time.

dependencies.name: httpx
dependencies.purpose: HTTP client for the Quilla defensive crawler (operator tooling).
dependencies.security_relevance: Performs outbound HTTP for crawler; review TLS/redirect handling.
dependencies.why_needed: HTTP/2-capable client for fetching open-source intel sources.

dependencies.name: anyio
dependencies.purpose: Async compatibility layer used by httpx.
dependencies.security_relevance: Async runtime abstraction; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Required by httpx for async transport.

dependencies.name: certifi
dependencies.purpose: Mozilla CA bundle for TLS verification.
dependencies.security_relevance: Trust store; must stay current for TLS integrity.
dependencies.why_needed: TLS certificate validation for crawler HTTP requests.

dependencies.name: h11
dependencies.purpose: HTTP/1.1 protocol implementation used by httpcore.
dependencies.security_relevance: Protocol parsing; review for parser vulnerabilities.
dependencies.why_needed: HTTP/1.1 wire protocol for httpx.

dependencies.name: h2
dependencies.security_relevance: Protocol parsing; review for parser vulnerabilities.
dependencies.why_needed: HTTP/2 support for httpx.

dependencies.name: hpack
dependencies.security_relevance: Header compression; review for header-injection issues.
dependencies.why_needed: Required by h2.

dependencies.name: hyperframe
dependencies.security_relevance: Frame parsing; review for parser vulnerabilities.
dependencies.why_needed: Required by h2.

dependencies.name: httpcore
dependencies.security_relevance: Connection transport; review TLS and connection pooling.
dependencies.why_needed: Low-level HTTP transport used by httpx.

dependencies.name: idna
dependencies.security_relevance: Domain-name parsing; review for IDN spoofing handling.
dependencies.why_needed: IDN normalization for URLs in httpx.

dependencies.name: beautifulsoup4
dependencies.purpose: HTML parsing for the Quilla crawler's extractor.
dependencies.security_relevance: Parses untrusted HTML; review for parser-based issues.
dependencies.why_needed: Structured extraction from fetched open-source pages.

dependencies.name: lxml
dependencies.security_relevance: Native parser of untrusted content; review for CVEs.
dependencies.why_needed: Fast, robust HTML/XML parsing for the extractor.

dependencies.name: soupsieve
dependencies.security_relevance: Selector parsing; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: CSS selector support for BeautifulSoup.

dependencies.name: pydantic
dependencies.security_relevance: Input validation; review for model-parsing issues.
dependencies.why_needed: Typed validation of crawler config and bundle schemas.

dependencies.name: annotated-types
dependencies.purpose: Annotated type metadata used by pydantic.
dependencies.security_relevance: Type metadata; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Required by pydantic for annotated constraints.

dependencies.name: cryptography
dependencies.purpose: Cryptography for bundle signing and PKCS#7 path building.
dependencies.security_relevance: Core crypto; sensitive — keep current with pyca advisories.
dependencies.why_needed: Signs and verifies threat-intel bundles.

dependencies.name: cffi
dependencies.purpose: C foreign-function interface used by cryptography.
dependencies.security_relevance: FFI layer for crypto bindings; review for memory-safety issues.
dependencies.why_needed: Bindings for OpenSSL in cryptography.

dependencies.name: pycparser
dependencies.security_relevance: Build-time parser for cffi; not directly sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Required by cffi to parse C declarations.

dependencies.name: github.com/spf13/cobra
dependencies.purpose: CLI framework for the CoreGuard CLI.
dependencies.security_relevance: CLI argument parsing; not sensitive.
dependencies.why_needed: Command/flag structure for the Go CLI.
